proposal.inferred_root_cause: undeclared outage at upi:paytm: 4% success over 214 attempts with nothing published yet
proposal.reasoning_trace: upi:paytm is effectively down at 4% success over 214 attempts against a 90% baseline, with the breaker already half-open, and the only open notice names upi:ybl, a different issuer on the same method. Nothing is published for this issuer, but a rate this low over this many attempts is not sampling noise; the notice is lagging the failure. The open notice on upi:ybl is a different issuer and explains nothing here. Attempt 3 failing identically rules out a one-off switch error. This is a recurring debit, so RBI's 24-hour cooling window is longer than any backoff this class would justify: the timing is set by regulation, not by the hazard estimate, and the pre-debit notice has to go out before the retry does.
